documented_examples.notes: The README uses this query to illustrate retrieval. It identifies rendering as the subsystem for sprite and camera work. The server also indexes camera under aiming.

evaluation.query: Repair multiplayer snapshot serialization.
evaluation.notes: Serializing snapshots is part of multiplayer networking. The word repair also contains the unrelated keyword ai.

evaluation.query: Investigate why client snapshots are not sent through the transport.
evaluation.notes: Sending snapshots to clients belongs to network transport. The query also exercises the plural snapshots.

evaluation.query: Fix interpolation and snapshot synchronization for online multiplayer.
evaluation.notes: Interpolating synchronized state from network snapshots is a networking concern.

evaluation.query: Why are sprite textures blurred in the animation?
evaluation.notes: Sprite appearance and animation are part of rendering.

evaluation.query: Update the camera draw order for sprite animation.
evaluation.notes: The task concerns visual drawing order. Camera and draw are shared keywords, but sprite animation narrows the task to rendering.

evaluation.query: Sprites and textures flicker.
evaluation.notes: Sprite and texture flicker is a visual rendering defect. Both nouns use their plural forms.

evaluation.query: Fix collision and raycast behavior when an obstacle blocks the path.
evaluation.notes: Collision and obstacle raycasts are maintained by the physics subsystem.

evaluation.query: Why do raycasts miss obstacles?
evaluation.notes: Raycasts against obstacles are a physics operation. Both relevant indexed terms appear as plurals.

evaluation.query: Enemy AI should chase and then flee from the target.
evaluation.notes: Enemy chase and flee behavior belongs to the AI subsystem.

evaluation.query: Repair enemies that wander before aggro.
evaluation.notes: Wandering and aggro transitions belong to enemy AI, even without the literal term AI.

evaluation.query: Fix projectile damage and weapon attack timing.
evaluation.notes: The requested change is damage and attack timing, rather than trajectory aiming or network replication.

evaluation.query: Projectiles and weapons fire but deal no damage.
evaluation.notes: Projectile and weapon damage is a combat behavior. The query uses plural weapon and projectile forms.

evaluation.query: Fix the keyboard and gamepad controls for WASD movement.
evaluation.notes: Keyboard and gamepad controls belong to input handling.

evaluation.query: Support multiple controllers and keyboards.
evaluation.notes: Supporting controllers and keyboards belongs to input handling. Both indexed device types appear in plural form.

evaluation.query: Repair the UI tooltip and progress bar overlay.
evaluation.notes: Tooltips, progress bars and overlays are documented UI framework responsibilities.

evaluation.query: The music starts twice after loading a saved game.
evaluation.notes: The visible symptom is duplicate music playback. Saved and loading can favor services and asset loading instead of audio.

evaluation.query: Raycasts stop at empty doorways in the latest build.
evaluation.notes: The raycast hits an empty opening. Doorways contains door and latest contains test, so the query can also retrieve dungeon generation and developer tools.

evaluation.query: Survival mode hangs when leaving the lobby.
evaluation.notes: The primary task is diagnosing a game-mode transition. Lobby also belongs to other subsystems, and mode contains the equipment keyword mod.

evaluation.query: Headless screenshot output is black at 1920x1080.
evaluation.notes: The symptom is in the headless screenshot tool. Screenshot contains screen, which is indexed for aiming.

evaluation.query: A single trigger press sometimes makes the rifle fire two projectiles instead of one.
evaluation.notes: The primary task is diagnosing duplicate projectile firing from a single trigger press. Fire and projectile overlap with the aiming index.

evaluation.query: The gamepad fails to reconnect after I unplug it.
evaluation.notes: The device fails to reconnect. Input is the primary label; fails also contains ai.

evaluation.query: The tooltip remains on screen after closing the dialog.
evaluation.notes: The tooltip should disappear with its dialog. Remains contains ai, and screen is an aiming keyword.

evaluation.query: In the latest build, the gamepad stops responding after reconnecting.
evaluation.notes: The symptom concerns gamepad input. Latest contains test, and build contains ui.

evaluation.query: The client applies the same snapshot twice after reconnecting.
evaluation.notes: Client snapshot handling belongs to multiplayer networking. Twice contains ice, a Core & Fusion keyword.

evaluation.query: The player loses keyboard control when a second gamepad connects.
evaluation.notes: The symptom concerns input devices. Keyboard contains key, and player contains play.

evaluation.query: The health bar is the wrong color. The health value is correct.
evaluation.notes: Only the display color is wrong. Health can rank combat or damage; heal is also a substring of health.
